implementation.targetScope: useSize for React 19 HTML elements, physical border-box dimensions, and the unchanged Popper 1.4.0 arrow caller.

changes: Ignore stale-target sizes before effect replacement.
Coalesce notifications into one frame and preserve snapshot identity for identical dimensions.
Use the target window for observation and scheduling; ignore late notifications after cleanup.
Map logical border-box dimensions to physical width/height in vertical writing modes; fall back to offsets for missing or empty boxes.
Without ResizeObserver, provide initial/window-resize measurements without claiming continuous element-size tracking.
